name: emergency_watchdog

storage.rationale: The safeguard installs the standalone watchdog binary into the invoking user's native scheduler (systemd, launchd, or Task Scheduler); it writes only user-scoped state and needs no privilege.

description: Install the portable emergency watchdog and its native user scheduler entry so setup owns the last line of defense instead of a hand-placed unit

setpoint_path.description: Optional path to the shared reliability setpoint. Pressure and sustain bars are read from this contract by the installed watchdog binary.

notes: The watchdog's pressure thresholds are declared in infrastructure-manager/setpoint/reliability-setpoint.json; this manifest intentionally carries no private CPU deadband. The portable report-only decision binary reads hostpressure directly. Platform scheduling remains owned by each host's native scheduler.

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.
